one_month_reasoning: No Adobe-scheduled catalyst falls inside 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-30: Q4 FY26 results are expected ~Dec 9, Adobe MAX runs Nov 10-12 and Chakravarthy takes over as CEO Dec 1, all after the window. Wadhwani's exit (effective Sep 27) is already public and priced since the Sep 3 announcement. In-window drivers are exogenous: late-October software/mega-cap earnings, AI-design-tool launches, and the Oct 28 FOMC (hike odds eased after the softer Aug PCE on Sep 30). Post-earnings drift after the 'beat but soft Q4 guide' is mildly negative and the buyback (~$2.2B/quarter) is mildly supportive; they roughly cancel. I therefore use a near-symmetric lognormal centred at ~$237.5 with monthly vol ~11.7% (41%/3.5), with a hair of extra left tail for leadership-vacuum headlines.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep 2027 ~$29.4 = 2/12 FY27 $27.67 + 10/12 FY28 ~$30.0, trimmed slightly for December-guide reset risk, x 9.0x = $265; weight 0.6) and after-SBC FCF yield (~$25.0/share NTM on ~365M shares at 9.5% = $263, less ~$2/share net debt = $261; weight 0.4). No buyback-accretion bump (accretion is already in the lower share count) and no re-rating assumed.

inputs_detail.derivation: Aggregator figure (single source, medium quality) as fact-checked by the round-1 supervisor.

Adobe's fiscal year ends late November (Q3 ended Aug 28, 2026), so NTM at 2027-09-30 = 2/12 x $27.67 + 10/12 x $30.0 = $29.6; trimmed ~0.7% for the risk that the first FY27 guide under a new CEO, interim CFO and without the Creative business head (Wadhwani, 8-K) is reset lower.

Stock trades ~8.0x my horizon-NTM EPS and ~8.8x current NTM. I hold roughly today's multiple (a touch above the horizon-NTM figure because buybacks and ~9% after-SBC FCF yield limit compression) but lower than round 1's 9.5x because the leadership vacuum in the core Creative business and ~37% y/y Q3 net new ARR decline argue against any re-rating; bear-leaning newsletters (Hated Moats, Pursuit of Compounding, Eagle Talon) frame it as guilty until proven innocent.

inputs_detail.derivation: Deducted as a real cost (round-1 supervisor finding: pricing pre-SBC FCF at 9.5% already embeds a re-rating).
TTM ~$8.47B grown ~7.5% (organic ARR growth ~8-9% per the FY guide arithmetic, modest margin leverage offset by AI compute costs).

389.2M outstanding on Sep 18, 2026 (10-Q cover), Q4 diluted guide 389M; ~$2.2B/quarter buyback at ~$240 retires ~9M gross, ~7.5M net of issuance per quarter -> ~360M; I use 365M allowing for a slower pace if the price rises.
Total debt $6.363B less cash and ST investments $5.639B.
Today's after-SBC FCF yield is ~9.1% (~$21.8/share TTM on 389.2M shares at $238). 9.5% is a slightly higher yield than today, i.e. no re-rating, reflecting terminal-growth doubt from AI substitution.

bear.story: The first FY27 guide (~Dec 9) under new CEO Chakravarthy, an interim CFO and with the Creative & Productivity president (Wadhwani) gone resets organic ARR growth to ~5-6%; Q4 net new ARR misses even the guide-implied ~$0.78B; stock-content and entry seats keep leaking to Canva / model-native tools. EPS ~$27.5 at ~6x = ~$165.

base.story: Q4 net new ARR lands near the guide-implied ~$0.78B (-16% y/y, less bad than Q3's -37%), FY27 organic ARR growth ~8%, EPS grows ~10% with buybacks cutting the count toward ~365M; multiple stays ~8.5x NTM EPS ~$29.5 = ~$250-255.

bull.story: Freemium funnel (>100M creative MAU; adobe.com traffic rising Jun-Aug 2026) converts, AI-first ARR (>$650M, +150%) compounds, new CEO lands pricing and agentic enterprise story; re-rate to ~11x NTM EPS ~$30.5 = ~$335.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$175 (well under the $190 52-week low; ~6x NTM EPS of ~$29.4 and a ~12-13% after-SBC FCF yield) the price would most likely reflect a fundamental break: a December FY27 guide implying organic ending-ARR growth at or below ~5%, a margin reset, or evidence of outright Creative Cloud seat churn to AI-native tools, compounded by an execution gap after the core-business president's departure. Ordinary 41%-vol swings rarely take a ~9x P/E stock with a ~$2.2B/quarter buyback that low without such news.

Alt-data is colour, not a valuation input: adobe.com visits rose Jun->Aug 2026 (Semrush 352M -> 406M -> 498M, likely partly seasonal) while Canva still leads the category (~864M visits, +5% m/m, Similarweb); the single-month Firefly web-traffic drop from round 1 is dropped as noise

reasoning: Round 2 incorporates the supervisor's fact-checks. (1) SBC: I now deduct ~$2.1B/yr SBC and drop the buyback-accretion bump, which double-counted the lower share count; the FCF leg falls from $295 to $261. (2) Share count: 389.2M on the 10-Q cover (not 391M), falling to ~365M by Sep 2027 at ~$2.2B/quarter. (3) NTM EPS: Adobe's November fiscal year makes horizon-NTM ~2/12 FY27 + 10/12 FY28 = ~$29.6; I use $29.4. (4) Management: I confirmed with a second source (CNBC, Yahoo) that Creative & Productivity president David Wadhwani left (announced Sep 3, effective Sep 27); I cut my multiple from 9.5x to 9.0x and fattened the bear case (prob 0.25 -> 0.27, price $170 -> $165). (5) Net new ARR: the -37% y/y Q3 figure is organic; the FY guide implies ~-16% y/y in Q4, a less-bad bar for December, which partly offsets. (6) Source review: I dropped the single-month Firefly traffic, the Blind thread and the 'reportedly' Stocktwits item as forecast inputs. As the supervisor suggested, I checked a multi-month series: Semrush shows adobe.com at 352M (Jun), 406M (Jul), 498M (Aug 2026), rising strongly (partly back-to-school seasonality), while Similarweb has Canva at ~864M visits, +5% m/m. That is neutral to mildly positive top-of-funnel colour and moves no number. Result: fair value $263 (was $292), my own and below the supervisor's $272 because I apply a lower multiple for the leadership gap and a more conservative share-count path. The price distribution: base rates of 41% realized vol and a typical large-cap +/-25-35%; I use a lognormal with median ~$245 (was ~$250) and sigma ~0.39, with a slightly fatter left tail (December reset path) and thinner far-right tail. Scenario mean ~$248 (bear $165 27%, base $252 50%, bull $335 23%). P(>=238) 0.53, P(>=190) 0.735, P(>=321) 0.235. Research this round was limited to 2 searches and 2 fetches.
